job.title: Data Engineer II, AWS Analytics Engineering
job.pay_full: $132,100 – $178,800 a year base salary (Seattle), plus sign-on payments and restricted stock units

details.about: AWS Analytics Engineering (AAE) is the analytics backbone of AWS: it builds and runs the data platform behind business decisions across more than 250 AWS services, processing petabytes of data a day through thousands of jobs. This Data Engineer II owns data pipelines and analytical models in one or more data domains, improves high-value datasets and works with AWS service teams on data requirements, data contracts and ingestion.
duties: Design, build and optimize logical data models and pipelines for difficult datasets, turning loosely defined requirements into secure, testable, maintainable solutions
Own the quality and operational health of assigned datasets and pipelines: monitoring, alarms, runbooks, validation and SLA tracking, plus the team's on-call rotation
Contribute to data architecture and design decisions for the solutions you own
Build and operate infrastructure for your data solutions using automation and team standards
Work with AWS service teams and analytics customers on requirements, data contracts, data quality and self-service access
Own projects or major components from design through launch and operations
Take part in code and design reviews and begin mentoring less-experienced engineers
Explore AI/ML technologies, including LLMs and agentic workflows, to improve data work and analytics productivity
needs: Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
Experience in at least one scripting or programming language, such as Python, Java, Scala or NodeJS
Experience analysing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc.
Experience building or operating highly available, distributed systems for extracting, ingesting and processing large datasets
Experience managing projects and working independently
Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, engineering, analytics, mathematics, statistics, IT or equivalent
nice: AWS technologies such as Redshift, S3, Glue, EMR, Kinesis, Firehose, Lambda and IAM
Big data technologies such as Hadoop, Hive, Spark and EMR
Software engineering best practices across the full development life cycle
AI/ML technologies, including generative AI, LLM applications, agentic workflows or tool integration
Technical leadership and mentoring on data engineering best practices
details.benefits: Base salary $132,100 – $178,800 a year (Seattle). The package includes sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs); final pay depends on experience, qualifications and location. Benefits include medical, dental, vision and prescription cover, life and AD&D insurance, mental health support, flexible spending accounts, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, 401(k) matching, paid time off and parental leave.
notes: Amazon offers workplace accommodations during the hiring process for candidates with disabilities
